'''Eanjer Kunarazti''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] whose [[Eanjer Kunarazti's father|father]] owned [[Polestar Imports]]. Eanjer was [[Death/Legends|killed]], along with his father, by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Several weeks later, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], disguised as Eanjer, convinced [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Marblewood Estate heist|break into]] the [[Marblewood Estate]] to supposedly retrieve money that [[Black Sun sector chief|Black Sun Sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]] had stolen. However, it was simply a plot to allow Fett to kill a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] named [[Qazadi]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
